mentions.quote: the market looks strong and then just completely ignoring it when the market gives you what you wanted in the first place

key_insights: Bitcoin is in an uptrend with strong momentum but lacks meaningful pullback opportunities
Two types of pullbacks to watch: shallow (open interest wipe with price and OI down) or deep (to daily/weekly/monthly levels)
Key resistance zone exists between $44-47k, with monthly range midpoint at $46.8k
Early resistance may start around $41.8-43k as approaching weekly levels
If market continues melting up without pullbacks, traders must decide between missing entries or trading lower time frames
Trading lower time frames carries risk of entering during high timeframe pullbacks that turn into larger declines

trading_ideas.entry: near daily/weekly opens on lower time frames
trading_ideas.speaker: Cred

summary: Cred analyzes Bitcoin's current market state, noting the strong uptrend but lack of quality pullback entry points. He outlines two scenarios: waiting for a shallow open-interest flush or deeper pullbacks to key levels ($37k daily, $35k monthly, $32k weekly). He warns of resistance at $44-47k and advises traders to either wait for high timeframe retests or carefully manage risk when trading lower time frames, as entries during small pullbacks can turn into larger corrections.
